about: A SQL translator, written in Rust, that rewrites queries between more than 30 database dialects.

prs.title: Division in SQLite queries keeps whole-number results
prs.broken: Translating a query to or from SQLite changed every division to decimal math, so 7 / 2 gave 3.5 where the database gives 3.
prs.changed: I made that change only when the source database really does decimal division.
prs.matters: Translated queries return the same numbers as the originals.

prs.title: Date formatting from DuckDB to SQLite works
prs.broken: DuckDB date-formatting calls were copied to SQLite with their two parts in the wrong order, so every row came back empty.
prs.changed: I made the translator swap the two parts for SQLite, as it already did for other databases.
prs.matters: Reports moved from DuckDB to SQLite show their dates.
